title.narrative: Creating training and employment opportunities for Palestine refugee youth in Lebanon

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to improve the living conditions and the resilience of the most vulnerable Palestine refugee youth - both those displaced by the Syrian crisis (PRS) and the vulnerable communities which host them in Lebanon (PRL), through support for increased livelihood opportunities and stability.

The specific objective of the project is: increased access to livelihoods opportunities with gender sensitive focus for the self-reliance of vulnerable and poor PRL and PRS
